title: QA Senior Automation Engineer
description:
**Position:**  
QA Senior Automation Engineer
  
  
**Job Description:**  
**Experience:** 5–9 Years
  
  

* Design, develop and maintainautomated test scripts and reusable automation components for desktop, web, mobile and hardware-integrated applications.
* Strong hands-on experience inPython, Robot Framework, Karate Framework, PyTest, Selenium, Playwright and/or Appium.
* Experience indesktop, web and mobile automation, UI controls, application workflows and system integration testing.
* Automate end-to-end scenarios coveringevent triggering, application verification and system/hardware output validation.
* Develop automation utilities fortest data, logging, reporting and execution management.
* Execute regression suites and performfailure analysis and troubleshooting.
* Work with the Architect/Lead and development teams to enhance and maintain the automation framework.
* Knowledge ofCI/CD, Git and industrial/embedded systems will be an advantage.

**Location:**  
IN-GJ-Ahmedabad, India-Ognaj (eInfochips)
  
  
**Time Type:**  
Full time
  
  
**Job Category:**  
Engineering Services
